2607.21530.title: From Resource Flow to Executable Tests: Petri-Net-Guided LLM Test Generation for Concurrent Stateful Rust APIs
2607.21530.paper_summary: Concurrent stateful library APIs expose behavior through evolving resource ownership, lifecycle states, and competing interleavings. Large language models can synthesize executable Rust tests, but their outputs often violate API preconditions, remain shallow, or reduce concurrency to accidental sequential traces. Conversely, model-based and systematic testing techniques provide semantic control but commonly require substantial handwritten code to turn abstract scenarios into executable tests. This paper addresses the gap between formal scenario design and low-cost test concretization. We present a Petri-net-guided methodology for test generation over concurrent stateful Rust APIs. The method represents API resources, lifecycle conditions, and causal dependencies as colored tokens and transitions; derives legal deep-state, near-legal, and partial-order concurrent scenarios; and uses these scenarios as a constrained intermediate representation for LLM-based code synthesis. A local-faithfulness contract and structural repair loop preserve the modeled intent during concretization, while Petri-guided schedule shaping prioritizes high-conflict concurrency skeletons for systematic exploration. A layered semantic oracle then distinguishes synthesis failures from violations of the target API's expected behavior.
2607.21530.paper_summary_zh: 同時狀態庫 API 通過不斷演變的資源擁有權、生命週期狀態和競爭交錯來暴露行為。大型語言模型可以合成可執行的 Rust 測試，但它們的輸出經常違反 API 前提條件、保持淺顯，或將並發性降低為偶然的順序痕跡。相反，基於模型和系統化測試技術提供語義控制，但通常需要大量手寫代碼將抽象場景轉化為可執行測試。本文解決了正式場景設計與低成本測試具體化之間的差距。我們提出了一種基於 Petri 網的測試生成方法，適用於並發狀態 Rust API。該方法將 API 資源、生命週期條件和因果依賴表示為彩色標記和轉換；推導合法的深度狀態、近合法和部分有序的並發場景；並將這些場景用作基於 LLM 的代碼合成的約束中間表示。局部忠實性合約和結構修復循環在具體化過程中保留建模意圖，而基於 Petri 的調度塑形則優先考慮高衝突的並發骨架以進行系統化探索。然後，分層語義神諭區分合成失敗與目標 API 預期行為的違反。
2607.21530.author: Kaiwen Zhang et.al.
